text: Hello and welcome to our live coverage of this London Derby from the Premier League as West Ham host Chelsea!
These two rivals are both targeting a first win of the season at the London Stadium.
West Ham were pegged back in a 1-1 draw at Bournemouth last time out, with Dominic Solanke levelling for the Cherries after Jarrod Bowen's stunning strike put the Hammers ahead.
Following a turbulent pre-season, the signings of Edson Alvarez and James Ward-Prowse have lifted the mood at the London Stadium – can West Ham cause an upset here?
Chelsea produced an admirable performance in their first league game under Mauricio Pochettino last Sunday, drawing 1-1 with Liverpool at Stamford Bridge.
They've since enjoyed another eventful week in the transfer market, making Moises Caicedo the most expensive player in British football history and adding a second young midfielder in Romeo Lavia.
Will Pochettino's first competitive win as Blues boss come at the home of their rivals?

David Moyes makes just one change from the Hammers side that started on the south coast last week, bringing former Southampton skipper Ward-Prowse in for his West Ham debut as Fornals drops to the bench.
Fellow new arrival Alvarez is also among the substitutes, while Paqueta – who is subject to a Football Association investigation over alleged violations of betting rules – starts.
Pochettino also keeps alterations to a minimum as Gusto replaces injured captain Reece James on the right.
New £115million signing Caicedo starts on the bench as Gallagher partners Fernandez in midfield, while Lavia – a £58m acquisition from Southampton – is not involved.
Chelsea have won 149 London Derbies in the Premier League and are looking to become just the second side to record 150 victories in such games, after Arsenal.
Will the Blues reach that landmark here? The teams are out, and kick-off is fast approaching!
We're under way at the London Stadium as Jackson gets the ball rolling for Chelsea!
The atmosphere is electric in east London as West Ham play their first competitive home game since last season's Europa Conference League triumph.
The fact there is no love lost between these two clubs also helps! Chukwuemeka lifts a cross into the box, but Aguerd is there to clear.
Paqueta goes down following a West Ham throw on the left, with the Hammers initially playing on as they attempted to break.
The Brazil international landed awkwardly and seems to be in discomfort.
Paqueta is helped to his feet by the West Ham medical team.
He will play on despite landing awkwardly following a tussle with Gallagher.
GOOD SAVE! West Ham win the first corner of the game on the right, giving new man Ward-Prowse a chance to show off his set-piece skills.
His deep delivery is flicked goalwards by Zouma with Bowen ready to pounce, but Sanchez gets down to punch it clear.
This is a positive start from West Ham.
Coufal breaks into the area and forces Gallagher to slide the ball behind for another corner.

GOOAAAAAL! AGUERD PUTS WEST HAM AHEAD! Ward-Prowse needed just seven minutes to make his set-piece prowess count! His deep corner is met by Aguerd at the far post, with the Morocco international climbing above Gallagher to power a header into the bottom-left corner.
1-0 to the Irons!

Ward-Prowse gets the first assist of his West Ham career, lifting a textbook set-piece delivery onto the head of Aguerd! Gallagher could do nothing against the Hammers defender – that was a real mismatch at the far post!
IS IT A PENALTY? Jackson darts onto Gusto's throughball to round Areola, who clips the Chelsea striker and sends him tumbling to the ground.
The referee looks to point to the spot, but the linesman is flagging for offside.
VAR will take a look at this!
NO PENALTY! Following a VAR review, offside is the decision and West Ham escape.
That was a close call – Chelsea almost hit back immediately!
We've had a thrilling start to this London Derby.
Chelsea may be behind, but Jackson looks like a real handful playing on the shoulder of West Ham's defence.
Aguerd goes into the book for cynically stopping Sterling from breaking down the right.
Moments earlier, Antonio had Colwill backpedalling as he charged into the box, but the Hammers striker failed to get his shot away.
OVER! Chelsea's stand-in captain Chilwell provides a brilliant cross from the left, but Jackson gets under his header and sends it comfortably over the crossbar from six yards out.
That was a good chance!
Ward-Prowse has now provided 24 assists from dead-ball situations in the Premier League, the second most of any player since his debut in the competition in 2012-13, behind Christian Eriksen (25).
West Ham apply more pressure as Soucek and Coufal combine on the right, before Benrahma sees a shot blocked.
Jackson looks to lead a Chelsea counter, but former Blues defender Zouma cuts it out.
Sterling sets off on a run and beats Emerson for pace, but his powerful delivery from the right is gathered by Areola.
Chelsea are struggling to find a way through.
Fernandez finds Sterling running in behind Emerson, and the England international wins a corner on the Chelsea right.
Chilwell's delivery is flicked on by Silva, but Areola comes through the crowd to claim the loose ball.
Good goalkeeping.
Gallagher lines up a strike from range, which Areola uncomfortably parries... but Jackson clears the crossbar with his volley on the follow-up!
Chukwuemeka shows great strength to outmuscle Soucek and reach the byline, but his cutback is poor and Zouma can clear the danger.
Jackson and Sterling were both lurking in dangerous positions.
Wide! Fernandez's deep cross finds Chilwell on the far side of the area, but he glances his header well wide of Areola's right-hand post.
Chelsea are looking more threatening now.
Sterling has the chance to thread Jackson through on goal, but his pass is slightly underhit and Aguerd gets back in time to clear.
A better ball would've resulted in a one-on-one.
West Ham have lost 11 of their last 16 Premier League London derbies (W2 D3), with both wins in that run coming against Fulham last season.
The Hammers have lost more London derbies in the Premier League than any other side (119), but they've started this one well.
GOAAAAAAAL! CHUKWUEMEKA LEVELS FOR CHELSEA! The Blues' pressure tells as Chilwell's cross is only cleared as far as Chukwuemeka.
The former Aston Villa man has plenty to do after picking up the ball on the left side of the box, but he cuts inside Soucek to fire a brilliant finish into the far corner! 1-1!

events.action: fire a brilliant finish into the far corner

text: Chelsea will feel that goal had been coming.
They have moved the ball nicely and almost got in behind on several occasions, but it took a moment of magic from Chukwuemeka to open West Ham up!
Chelsea are definitely on top now.
Sterling is involved in another attack, which ends with Chilwell winning a corner on the visitors' left.
Fernandez's delivery is attacked by Colwill, but the former Brighton and Hove Albion loanee sends his downward header wide.
That was a decent opening – West Ham's marking was lax!
Chelsea's equaliser has quietened what was a boisterous home crowd.
West Ham look to build down the right, but Coufal's cross is headed away by Gusto.

Unlucky! That man Jackson darts in behind again, reaching the byline before cutting the ball back, but nobody is there to turn it home for Chelsea! The Blues come again, and Paqueta bizarrely lets the ball run behind for a corner to the visitors.
Paqueta is booked for petulantly kicking the ball away before the Chelsea corner, which comes to nothing.
Disasi follows Paqueta into the book after bringing Antonio down with a reckless challenge to prevent a West Ham break down the right.
CLOSE! Paqueta almost restores West Ham's lead with a left-footed volley, but he's just off-balance as he shoots and it drifts narrowly wide of the bottom-right corner.
Chelsea continue to threaten.
Sterling looks to break in behind and put it on a plate for Jackson, but the winger is just offside from Fernandez's lofted pass.
Chukwuemeka just overruns the ball before diving into a challenge with Emerson, catching the former Chelsea full-back on the follow-through.
The Blues goalscorer sees yellow for that offence.
PENALTY TO CHELSEA! West Ham cannot cope with Sterling! The winger sets off on a slaloming run, beating several West Ham challenges before Soucek brings him down.
The Hammers midfielder looked to make contact just inside the area, though there will be a VAR review to check exactly where the foul took place.
The penalty stands! The review is swiftly over.
Soucek fouled Sterling on the line, so Fernandez has a chance to put Chelsea ahead from the spot!

PENALTY SAVED BY AREOLA! Fernandez goes for the bottom-left corner, but his kick is at a comfortable height for Areola, who springs to his right to parry it away! It remains 1-1 at the London Stadium!
It's a big moment for Areola, who has been battling Fabianski for West Ham's number one shirt.
In truth, however, Fernandez's penalty was poor, lacking power and placement.
Emerson goes into the book for a dreadful challenge on Sterling.
This game is getting feisty as we approach the break!
We're into SIX additional minutes at the end of a thrilling first half in east London.
BIG CHANCE! Sterling has been exceptional here, and he sets up another clear-cut opportunity by darting past Emerson before cutting the ball back towards the penalty spot.
Jackson misses it, before Chilwell sees his powerful effort blocked at close quarters.
West Ham need half-time!
West Ham have been camped near their own penalty area for much of this first half.
Chelsea are playing some fine football, but they need to start converting these chances.
Chelsea attack down the left again, but Soucek wins a foul off Chilwell to ease the pressure.
Chelsea goalscorer Chukwuemeka then goes down, holding his knee.

Chukwuemeka is the third player with the initials CC to score a Premier League goal for a club beginning with C, after Chris Coleman for Crystal Palace and Carlton Cole for Chelsea and Charlton Athletic (own goals excluded).
Pochettino will be hoping he can shake off this knock.
This does not look promising for Chukwuemeka.
He is hobbling from the pitch as Mudryk prepares to take his place.
It looks like being a sad end to a positive half for the former Villa winger.
Chelsea will not make the change prior to half-time, playing the final moments of this opening period with 10 men.
HALF-TIME: WEST HAM 1-1 CHELSEA.
John Brooks blows the half-time whistle, bringing the curtain down on a breathless opening period at the London Stadium.
West Ham made a fine start as debutant Ward-Prowse saw his corner headed home by Aguerd, but Chelsea soon got on top, levelling when Chukwuemeka cut inside to fire past Areola.
The Blues had a golden chance to go 2-1 up when Sterling won a penalty shortly before the break, but Fernandez's tame spot-kick was repelled by Areola.
It's all to play for after the interval!
It's been another enterprising performance from Chelsea, who have enjoyed 78.9 per cent of the possession, penning West Ham back and racking up 11 shots, though only three have hit the target.
Goalscorer Chukwuemeka looks unlikely to play on after suffering an injury shortly before the break, which could be a major blow for the visitors.
Chukwuemeka has not emerged following the half-time break.
Mudryk, as expected, takes his place in the Chelsea frontline.
We're under way for the second half as Paqueta gets the ball rolling.
West Ham will be looking for an improvement after spending much of the opening period under pressure.
Chelsea have started the second half as they ended the first, in control of possession.
Gusto looks to link up with Sterling inside the area, but Emerson scrambles it clear.
Chelsea have won just five of their last 30 Premier League matches (D11 L14), their fewest wins across a 30-game span in the league since a run between December 1987 and October 1988.
Can they complete the turnaround after responding well to Aguerd's opener?
More last-ditch defending is required from West Ham as Sterling looks to find Mudryk with a cutback from the right.
Benrahma then goes up the other end and sends an angled effort across goal and wide, only for the flag to belatedly go up.
Some neat hold-up play from Jackson gets Chelsea on the front foot again as West Ham drop back into their shape.
The former Villarreal striker has been very lively here.
There's movement on the Chelsea bench – it looks like the Premier League's most expensive player Caicedo is about to enter the fray.
GOOOOAAAAAAAAAL! ANTONIO RESTORES WEST HAM'S LEAD! What a finish from the Hammers striker! Chelsea are caught cold as Ward-Prowse's long ball finds Antonio running in behind.
He shows great strength to hold off Disasi, before finding the bottom-left corner with a brilliant finish from the corner of the box! Out of absolutely nowhere, it's 2-1 to West Ham!

What a debut this has been for Ward-Prowse, who has his second assist! He capitalised on a loose bit of play from Chelsea to fire a ball over the top for Antonio, with Gusto playing the Irons striker onside.
The home fans are in fine voice.
West Ham have spent much of this game defending for their lives, but Antonio's predatory finish on the break has them 2-1 up.
Chelsea have it all to do again now!
West Ham have looked much more comfortable since retaking the lead, and Chelsea may need to shake things up.
Caicedo's entrance appears to be imminent!
Sterling sets off on yet another dangerous run, with Emerson clipping the winger and conceding a free-kick near the corner of the box.
The left-back is already on a booking – he needs to be careful.
Fernandez swings the resulting free-kick towards the back post, but a claret shirt gets there to head it clear as West Ham escape.
Caicedo replaces Chilwell for his Chelsea debut.
That switch will surely mean a change of shape from the visitors.
What a challenge! Sterling looks to reach a throughball into the West Ham area, but Aguerd stretches out a leg to make a clean tackle, coming away with the ball when he had no margin for error!
West Ham are living dangerously! Sterling and Gallagher see close-range efforts blocked amid a scramble in the box, before Caicedo lashes a 20-yard strike over the crossbar.
Chelsea continue to press.
Antonio finds Benrahma on the break, and Gusto is forced to concede a corner with a desperate sliding challenge on the Algerian.
West Ham's counter-attacks have looked far more menacing in this second half.
Wide! Ward-Prowse's initial corner is cleared, but West Ham keep the pressure on and work the ball to Benrahma, who flashes a long-range strike wide of the bottom-left corner!

Ward-Prowse has become the first West Ham player to assist multiple goals on his Premier League debut for the club, with the Englishman being the 311th player to feature for the Hammers in the competition.
TWO YELLOW CARDS, AND AGUERD IS OFF! What is the defender doing? He slides in late on Jackson inside West Ham's half, sending the striker sprawling.
Having already been booked, Aguerd gave the referee no choice, and he is sent for an early bath! West Ham will have to defend this lead with 10 men!
Having seen his team reduced to 10 men, Moyes sacrifices Benrahma.
Ogbonna comes on to shore up West Ham's backline, with the hosts adopting a 4-4-1 shape.
How much of an impact with that dismissal have? West Ham had improved since retaking the lead, but Chelsea have 20 minutes plus stoppage time to find a response while playing with an extra man!
The crowd want a card shown to Gallagher following a trip on Paqueta.
The midfielder avoids a caution, but needless fouls like those will only play into West Ham's hands now.
Jackson is booked for protesting the referee's decision to award a foul against Gallagher.
Moyes has never beaten Pochettino in the Premier League in five previous attempts (D4 L1).
The only managers he has faced more often without winning in the competition are Pep Guardiola (11), Graham Potter (seven) and Mikel Arteta (seven).
Is the Scot about to end that hoodoo?
Chelsea make another attacking change as Madueke replaces Gallagher.
Madueke, Mudryk and Sterling are now playing off Jackson as Chelsea adopt a 4-2-3-1 shape.
Can they come from behind again in the final 15 minutes?
Moyes introduces Fornals in place of Antonio, who is set to be the match-winner if Chelsea cannot find another response.
Mudryk wins a free-kick on the left flank, which Fernandez plays short to Caicedo.
The Ecuador midfielder eventually hoists a cross towards the back post, but Soucek clears with a powerful header.
Bowen does brilliantly on the break to hold off four Chelsea defenders, before seeing his powerful 25-yard drive held by Sanchez at the second attempt.
Wide! Colwill seizes on a loose ball to shoot from 25 yards out, but his half-volley skims off the surface and goes just wide of the bottom-right corner.
West Ham hand a debut to newly signed defensive midfielder Alvarez, with the former Ajax man replacing Ward-Prowse.
He has had a debut to remember, teeing up both goals for the Hammers.
Sterling and Madueke link up on the right, with the latter seeing his cross deflect off Alvarez and go behind for a corner.
Twenty-year-old winger Burstow replaces Gusto as Chelsea throw another attacking player on.
West Ham clear back-to-back Chelsea corners, only for Sterling to keep the pressure on.
He lifts a delicate cross into the six-yard box, but Ogbonna reaches it with a fine clearing header.
The Blues come again, but Mudryk is flagged offside as he scoops a wild volley over.
Chelsea are running out of time to find a response here.
For all their attractive approach play, they have not managed a single shot on target since half-time.
Colwill steps forward before conceding a cheap foul, allowing West Ham a valuable breather.
The visitors have lacked composure against their depleted opponents.
That sums up Chelsea's second half.
Sterling lays it off to Fernandez, who sends an aimless chip straight to Areola.
The Argentine's first-half penalty miss looks likely to be pivotal here.
We will have a minimum of SIX additional minutes here! Can West Ham hang on?
ALMOST GAME OVER! Fornals breaks into the Chelsea area and bears down on Sanchez's goal.
The substitute goes for the bottom-left corner from a tight angle, but Sanchez pokes out a foot to make a big save and keep the score at 2-1!

SO CLOSE! Madueke's shot deflects off a West Ham defender and is tipped narrowly wide of the bottom-right corner by Areola! It's all hands on deck for West Ham now as Chelsea load crosses into the area.
PENALTY TO WEST HAM! The hosts have a chance to kill off this contest as Caicedo concedes a spot-kick! Paqueta finds Emerson with a cheeky backheel and the Chelsea debutant clumsily bundles him over.
It's a moment to forget for Caicedo, and Paqueta has a chance to make it 3-1!
GOAAAAAAAL! 3-1 TO WEST HAM, AND THE BRAGGING RIGHTS ARE THEIRS! Paqueta sends Sanchez the wrong way, planting his kick into the top-right corner.
West Ham have been terrific since the break, and the three points are staying at the London Stadium!
'I'm forever blowing bubbles' rings around the London Stadum – West Ham are moments away from a memorable win over their rivals!
FULL-TIME: WEST HAM 3-1 CHELSEA.

It's all over at the London Stadium as 10-man West Ham clinch a memorable 3-1 derby win over Chelsea! The Hammers were fortunate to go into half-time all square after Chukwuemeka cancelled out Aguerd's opener and Fernandez saw a penalty saved by Areola, but they were electric in the second period.

Antonio restored their lead with an outstanding finish on the break, and though Aguerd's second yellow card put the result in doubt, Paqueta made certain of the win with a late penalty following an error from Chelsea new boy Caicedo.
What a win for Moyes' men!
That result lifts West Ham up to sixth in the nascent Premier League table, and the Hammers will look to continue their unbeaten start when they visit Brighton and Hove Albion next Saturday.
Chelsea's wait for a first league win under Pochettino goes on, and they are next in action against Luton Town on Friday.
We hope you have enjoyed our live coverage of a thrilling Premier League clash from the London Stadium.
It's goodbye for now, and we'll see you next time!
